list_statistics.description: Find the BCRA's statistics by words in their name, category, series type or unit, such as 'reserves', 'exchange rate' or 'BADLAR', narrowed by category and frequency. Each comes with its ID, unit, frequency and latest value, so one step reads several at once. No API key required.
list_statistics.name: list_statistics

parameters.description: Words every statistic found must have in its name, category, series type or unit, in English. Leave empty to list them all.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Only statistics in this BCRA group, such as Main variables (the headline figures) or Daily Monetary Report. Leave empty for every group.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Only daily or only monthly statistics. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: frequency

parameters.description: Only these statistics, to read the latest value of several in one step. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: statistics

parameters.description: The most statistics to return, from 1 to 1,000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many statistics to pass over first, to page through: 0 for the first page, then the Limit for the next.
parameters.name: skip

count.description: How many are in this answer.

statistics.description: The statistics found, by ID, each with its latest value.

category.description: The BCRA's group for it, such as 'Main variables', 'Deposits by type of holder' or 'Daily Monetary Report'.

currency.description: Whether it counts pesos, foreign currency, or pesos and foreign currency together.

first_date.description: The first date it has a value for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

frequency.description: How often it is published: daily or monthly.

id.description: The statistic's ID at the BCRA (its idVariable), such as 1 for the international reserves. Every action that takes a statistic accepts it.

latest_date.description: The date of its latest value, as YYYY-MM-DD. A monthly figure is dated the last day of its month.

latest_value.description: Its latest value, in its unit.

name.description: The statistic's name as the BCRA gives it in English, such as 'Wholesale Exchange Rate'.

series_type.description: What kind of figure it is, such as 'Stocks' (a balance on the day), 'End of month stocks', 'Daily flows', 'Interest rates' or 'Exchange rate'.

unit.description: What its values are in, such as 'Millions of US dollars', 'Pesos per US dollar' or 'Nominal annual interest rate (%)'.

total.description: How many matched in all, before Limit and Skip.

description: Get the official data of the BCRA, Argentina's central bank: the official exchange rates and the day's quotes for about 40 currencies, currency conversion at those rates, the international reserves, interest rates such as BADLAR and TAMAR, inflation, the UVA and CER indexes and any of its 1,600 statistics; check whether a cheque has been reported; and compare the deposits, loans and cards banks offer. No account or API key required.
display_name: Banco Central de la República Argentina

bcra_new_exchange_rates_trigger.description: Runs when the BCRA publishes its exchange rates for a new day, leading with one currency's rate in pesos and its change from the day before, and carrying every currency's quote that day.

output.change: The change in its peso value from the day before.
output.count: How many currencies the day's table has.
output.currency: The currency the run leads with, such as USD.
output.currency_name: Its name in English, such as US dollar.
output.date: The day of the new quotes, as YYYY-MM-DD.
output.pesos_per_unit: What one unit of it is worth in pesos that day.
output.previous_date: The business day before it the BCRA published quotes for.
output.previous_pesos_per_unit: What one unit was worth in pesos the day before.
output.rates: Every currency's quote that day: code, name, pesos_per_unit and usd_per_unit.
output.usd_per_unit: What one unit of it is worth in US dollars that day.

parameters.description: The currency each run leads with, such as EUR. Leave blank for the US dollar. Every run also carries the whole day's table.
parameters.name: currency

bcra_new_statistic_value_trigger.description: Runs when the BCRA publishes a value for a new date in one of its statistics, such as the wholesale exchange rate, the international reserves or monthly inflation. Each run carries the previous value and the change.

output.category: The BCRA's group for it, such as Main variables.
output.change: The new value minus the previous one.
output.changed: True when the value differs from the previous one.
output.date: The date of the new value, as YYYY-MM-DD (the last day of its month for a monthly figure).
output.frequency: How often it is published: daily or monthly.
output.name: The statistic's name, such as Wholesale Exchange Rate.
output.previous_date: The date of the value before it.
output.statistic_id: The statistic's ID at the BCRA, such as 5.
output.unit: What its values are in, such as Pesos per US dollar.
output.value: The new value, as a number.

parameters.description: The statistic to watch, such as the wholesale exchange rate (ID 5), the international reserves (ID 1) or monthly inflation (ID 27).
parameters.name: statistic
